title: The Hollow Frames
tagline: Take the canvas, find the truth, choose who pays
inspiredBy: the 1990 theft from the Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum in Boston

client.intro.a.speaker: client
text: I am Silas, boss, and I still owe you for Naples in sixty four.

client.intro.b.speaker: client
text: I need that Harbor Moon canvas from the Vane House tonight, no questions.

client.intro.c.speaker: client
text: I am begging you, do not unroll it or look inside the tube, ever.

client.intro.repeat.speaker: client
text: Same building. Same job. Bring me the harbor moon canvas, Owl.

marlow.intro.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I am in the lobby and I see wide stairs and I hear a fountain dripping.

marlow.story.limp.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I hear keys on a tin cup and I am back to the night you lost your sight.

marlow.twist.tape.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I feel tape inside the tube and I hear Silas say your name.

client.got.speaker: client
text: You have it, good, now get out fast and do not stop for anyone.

client.checkin.speaker: client
text: I am waiting by the phone, Owl, tell me you have my canvas yet.

marlow.outro.win.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I am out on the street and I can hear the traffic and I am running.

client.tape.speaker: client
text: I am Silas and I order you to blind Owl and leave him for the police.

marlow.epilogue.ask.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, this tape proves Silas sold you out, what should I do now. Burn it, or send it?

marlow.epilogue.burn.speaker: marlow
text: I am holding the tape over the ashtray, boss, and I watch it curl and die.

marlow.epilogue.send.speaker: marlow
text: I am at the post box, boss, and I drop the tape to the papers.

client.after.burn.speaker: client
text: I knew I could trust you, Owl, and I will pay double by morning.

client.after.send.speaker: client
text: You fool, Owl, you burned us both and I will deny every word.

marlow.nudge.office.speaker: marlow
text: The harbor moon canvas is in the gallery, boss. Want me to head there?

marlow.nudge.take.speaker: marlow
text: It's right here, boss. Want me to take the harbor moon canvas?

marlow.nudge.exit.speaker: marlow
text: We have it. Back to the lobby and out, boss.

marlow.story.grand_hall.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I see a wide hall and I hear my shoes echo and I see police coats hung by Silas men.

marlow.story.blue_room.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I see blue walls and I hear the radiator hiss and I smell old smoke.

marlow.story.gallery.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I see empty frames on the wall and I hear the wire hum and I see your old fixers tag.

marlow.story.study.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I see ledgers and I hear the clock tick and I smell ink and dust.

marlow.lore.client.0.speaker: marlow
text: Silas is the client, boss. He was your partner before he betrayed you.

marlow.lore.client.1.speaker: marlow
text: Silas is the voice on the tape, boss. He ordered the men who blinded you.

marlow.lore.guard.0.speaker: marlow
text: Harlan is kind to cats, boss. He leaves milk by the blue room door.

marlow.lore.guard.1.speaker: marlow
text: Harlan is the guard, boss. He walks all night with keys and a tin cup.

marlow.lore.owner.0.speaker: marlow
text: Cornelia Vane is the owner, boss. She built this house for music in sixty one.

marlow.lore.item.0.speaker: marlow
text: Harbor Moon is the item, boss. It hides a tape inside its wooden tube.

marlow.lore.history.0.speaker: marlow
text: This job is inspired by the 1990 museum theft where fake police stole thirteen works that were never found, boss.

marlow.lore.marlow.0.speaker: marlow
text: I'm Marlow, boss. Your eyes.
